sections.title: Describe common symptoms
sections.content: Use *tener* expressions to say which symptoms you have. Keep the expression with *tener* in the first person when describing yourself.

items.english: I have a fever and a cough.

items.spanish: Tengo dolor de garganta y tos.
items.english: I have a sore throat and a cough.

sections.content: You can connect two symptoms with *y*: *Tengo fiebre y tos.*
